questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in the following sentence: 'Had I known about the meeting, I ________ it.'
Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood after the expression 'It is vital that'?
options: It is vital that he finishes the report by Friday.
It is vital that he finished the report by Friday.
It is vital that he finish the report by Friday.
It is vital that he has finished the report by Friday.
questions.answer: It is vital that he finish the report by Friday.

questions.question: Select the option that correctly completes the sentence with an appropriate cleft sentence structure: 'It was ________ the weather was so bad that the event was postponed.'
Which of the following sentences correctly uses ellipsis to maintain grammatical parallelism?
options: She likes swimming in the sea and hiking in the mountains.
She likes swimming in the sea and to hike in the mountains.
She likes to swim in the sea and hiking in the mountains.
She likes to swim in the sea and to hike in the mountains.
questions.answer: She likes swimming in the sea and hiking in the mountains.
